data.title: Liverpool sell minority stake to Jeff Bezos consortium
data.description: LONDON - Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell a minority stake in the Premier League club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

data.title: Democrats threaten EC over Senate case
data.description: <p>The Democrat Party has threatened legal action against the Election Commission (EC) if it drops the Senate vote-rigging case.</p>

data.title: PM swats away US drone base rumours
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed reports that the United States plans to establish a drone manufacturing base in Thailand, while reiterating that security matters are not linked to tariff negotiations and that the Cobra Gold military exercise will proceed as usual.</p>

data.title: Arpichaya in lead at Portland LPGA event
data.description: PORTLAND, Oregon - Thailand’s Arpichaya Yubol, ​in search of ⁠her first ⁠LPGA tournament win, holds ​a one-shot lead midway through the Standard Portland Classic.

data.title: Powerful earthquake kills at least 20 in Indonesia
data.description: MAUMERE, East Nusa Tenggara — A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, killing at least 20 people and sending thousands fleeing.

data.title: AWC cuts Asiatique tower to 56 storeys in major Chao Phraya revamp
data.description: AWC has revised its Asiatique redevelopment on Bangkok’s Chao Phraya riverfront, cutting a tower to 56 storeys and adding the Blue Dome, a cable car and MONA Bangkok.

data.title: Anutin to visit New Zealand, Australia
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will pay an official visit to Australia from Aug 17-20 and an official visit to New Zealand from Aug 20-22 at the invitation of the premiers of both countries, government spokesperson Rachada Dhnadirek said.</p>

data.title: Anutin sets out five priorities for air force
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined five policy priorities to strengthen the Royal Thai Air Force's (RTAF) operational capabilities and national security.</p>

data.title: Thailand, Wada seek closer cooperation
data.description: Thailand is working to strengthen its anti-doping system in line with international standards and deepen cooperation with the World Anti-Doping Agency (Wada).

data.title: Viennese woman sues city over 'discriminatory' toilet fees
data.description: VIENNA — A Viennese woman is suing the city council for discrimination over access to public toilets, complaining that women must pay to use cubicles while men can use urinals for free.

data.title: Japan defence minister visits war shrine, PM stays away
data.description: TOKYO — Japan's defence minister paid his respects Saturday at a shrine honouring the country's war dead that has long dogged Tokyo's relations with its Asian neighbours, but Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi stayed away.

data.title: Anutin to pay visits to NZ, Australia
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will pay an official visit to Australia from Aug 17-20 and an official visit to New Zealand from Aug 20-22 at the invitation of the premiers of both countries, government spokesperson Rachada Dhnadirek said.</p>

data.title: Venezuelan amputees adjust to new life after quakes
data.description: CARACAS - Teenage athlete Dennis Castillo spent 28 excruciating hours trapped under the rubble in quake-hit Venezuela, with a beam crushing her left leg as she waited to be rescued.

data.title: Venezuela frees more political prisoners amid post-Maduro talks
data.description: CARACAS - Venezuela freed dozens more political prisoners Friday, the government said, in a sign of progress in talks to reconcile the nation following Nicolas Maduro's ouster.

data.title: Ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism scandal found dead
data.description: LONDON - Black academic Jason Arday, who resigned from the University of Cambridge last week amid a high-profile plagiarism storm that featured racism claims, was found dead Friday, the prestigious British institution confirmed.

data.title: Powerful quake off Indonesia kills one, sparks mass evacuations
data.description: MAUMERE — A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, killing at least one person and sending thousands fleeing.

data.title: Poweful quake off Indonesia sparks mass evacuations
data.description: MAUMERE (INDONESIA) - A strong 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, sending thousands running in panic after authorities issued a tsunami warning.

data.title: Panel set to oversee data centres
data.description: <p>A national policy committee has been established to oversee the data centre industry, promoting investment while managing its impact on electricity, water, public safety and the environment.</p>

data.title: Poland eyes closer ties with Thailand
data.description: <p>Poland sees Thailand as a key middle-power partner, with the two countries sharing an interest in stronger economic ties, closer political dialogue and upholding a rules-based international order, according to Artur Harazim, Poland's Undersecretary of State for Foreign Affairs.</p>

data.title: President of BAAC faces investigation
data.description: <p>The Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives' (BAAC) board has appointed a representative from the Bank of Thailand to chair a committee tasked with investigating allegations raised by the BAAC labour union, which has accused the bank's president of failing in his duties.</p>

data.title: Govt says scheme isn't a handout
data.description: <p>The government yesterday said its "half-and-half interest" scheme is a funding programme for grassroots communities to reduce reliance on informal loans, not a cash handout.</p>
